# DAT-B B-2 — density of base-changed `K_s`-points in the relative curve

The separable-point density transfer of the DAT-B worksheet
(`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.5, COV-3): over a **separably closed** base field `k`
and any field extension `L ⊇ k`, the base changes of the `k`-rational points of the curve
`C` are dense in the relative curve `C_L = relCurve C L`: every nonempty open contains
one (`Over.dense_baseChange_rationalPoints`, the keystone).

The pointwise coverage theorem (B-5, worksheet §1.2 step 5) instantiates the admissible
point oracle of B-1 (`RiemannRoch/CoverageDrop.lean`) with these points at the fibre
field `L`; the vocabulary (the base-changed point, its triangles, the evaluations, the
tensor linear-independence heart) is in `Curve/SepPointsDenseKit.lean`.

## Route (worksheet §1.5 — elementary, no flatness-openness)

1. `C(k)` is dense in `C.left`: DAT-P (`Over.exists_rationalPoint_mem`).
2. A `k`-rational point base-changes to an `L`-point of `C_L`
   (`Over.rationalPointBaseChange`, kit).
3. The trace argument: on an affine chart `U` the sections of the base-changed chart
   are `Γ(U) ⊗_k L` on the nose (`Over.sectionsBaseChange`); reading a base-changed
   section at the base-changed point is `tensorPointEval` of the `k`-valued evaluation
   at the point (`gammaSpecIso_appLE_sectionsBaseChange`, the crux — proved on pure
   tensors through the two projection triangles and `ΓSpecIso`-naturality); a nonempty
   open contains a chart basic open `D(f)`, the nonzero coordinate `a` of `f` has
   nonempty `D(a)` in the **reduced** (integral) curve, DAT-P puts a rational point
   there, and its base change lands in `D(f)`.

The residue-degree bookkeeping of the base-changed point (`residueDeg L = 1`, the `hP`
oracle input of B-1) is *not* proved here; B-5 extracts it from the rationality
certificate `rationalPointBaseChange_snd`.  Every `appLE` transport below is an
equation-`have` consumed by `exact`/`DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom _)`
— the recorded I-0232(b)/I-0238(a)/(d) discipline; no structural `rw` into the product
spellings.
-/

263	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))

265	
266	/-- **COV-3, density of base-changed rational points** (★ B-2 keystone, worksheet
267	§1.5): over a separably closed base field `k`, for every field `L ⊇ k` and every
268	nonempty open `W` of the relative curve `C_L = relCurve C L`, some `k`-rational point
269	of `C` base-changes into `W`.
270	
271	Route: pick an affine chart `U` of `C.left` under a point of `W`; its preimage chart of
272	`C_L` is affine with sections `Γ(U) ⊗_k L` (`Over.sectionsBaseChange`); a basic open
273	`D(f) ⊆ W` of the chart has a nonzero coordinate `a` in an `L`-basis
274	(`exists_algHom_tensorPointEval_ne_zero`); `D(a)` is nonempty in the reduced curve, and
275	DAT-P (`Over.exists_rationalPoint_mem`) supplies a rational point there whose base
276	change evaluates `f` to a nonzero element of `L`
277	(`gammaSpecIso_appLE_sectionsBaseChange`), hence lies in `D(f) ⊆ W`. -/
278	theorem Over.dense_baseChange_rationalPoints [IsSepClosed k]
279	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsIntegral C.left]
280	    (W : (relCurve C L).Opens) (hW : (W : Set (relCurve C L)).Nonempty) :
281	    ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left) (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
282	      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) ∈ W := by
283	  classical
284	  obtain ⟨z, hzW⟩ := hW
285	  -- an affine chart of `C.left` under `z`, and its affine preimage chart of `C_L`
286	  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
287	    (X := C.left) (U := ⊤) (x := (fst C (overSpec k L)).left.base z) trivial
288	  haveI : IsAffineHom (fst C (overSpec k L)).left :=
289	    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsAffineHom)
290	      (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k L)).flip
291	      (isAffineHom_of_isAffine (overSpec k L).hom)
292	  have hV : IsAffineOpen ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) :=
293	    hU.preimage (fst C (overSpec k L)).left
294	  have hzV : z ∈ (fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U := hxU
295	  -- a basic open of the chart inside `W` around `z`
296	  obtain ⟨f, hfW, hzf⟩ := hV.exists_basicOpen_le
297	    (V := W ⊓ ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ⟨z, ⟨hzW, hzV⟩⟩ hzV
298	  -- its tensor coordinates: `f` is nonzero, hence has a nonzero coordinate
299	  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
300	    intro h0
301	    rw [h0, Scheme.basicOpen_zero] at hzf
302	    exact hzf
303	  have hF0 : (Over.sectionsBaseChange C L hU.isCompact hU.isQuasiSeparated).symm f
304	      ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hf0 (by
305	    rw [← (Over.sectionsBaseChange C L hU.isCompact hU.isQuasiSeparated).apply_symm_apply
306	      f, h0, map_zero])
307	  obtain ⟨a, ha0, hkey⟩ := exists_algHom_tensorPointEval_ne_zero hF0
308	  -- the coordinate's basic open is nonempty in the reduced curve; DAT-P fires there
309	  have hane : (C.left.basicOpen a : Set C.left).Nonempty := by
310	    by_contra h
311	    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot, basicOpen_eq_bot_iff] at h
312	    exact ha0 h
313	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpmem⟩ := Over.exists_rationalPoint_mem C (C.left.basicOpen a) hane
314	  have hple : ⊤ ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U :=
315	    top_le_preimage_of_closedPoint_mem p ((C.left.basicOpen_le a) hpmem)
316	  -- the base-changed point lies in the chart …
317	  have hqle : ⊤ ≤ Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp ⁻¹ᵁ
318	      ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) := by
319	    intro y _
320	    change (fst C (overSpec k L)).left.base
321	      ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base y) ∈ U
322	    have hbase : (fst C (overSpec k L)).left.base
323	        ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base y) =
324	        p.base ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))).base y) :=
325	      congr(($(Over.rationalPointBaseChange_fst C L p hp)).base y)
326	    refine Set.mem_of_eq_of_mem hbase ?_
327	    have hy : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))).base y =
328	        IsLocalRing.closedPoint k := Subsingleton.elim _ _
329	    rw [hy]
330	    exact (C.left.basicOpen_le a) hpmem
331	  -- … and evaluates `f` to a nonzero element of `L`
332	  have hval := gammaSpecIso_appLE_sectionsBaseChange C L p hp hU hple hqle
333	    ((Over.sectionsBaseChange C L hU.isCompact hU.isQuasiSeparated).symm f)
334	  rw [(Over.sectionsBaseChange C L hU.isCompact hU.isQuasiSeparated).apply_symm_apply f]
335	    at hval
336	  have hne0 : (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).appLE
337	      ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊤ hqle f ≠ 0 := by
338	    intro h0
339	    exact hkey (Over.rationalPointEval C p hp hple)
340	      (Over.rationalPointEval_ne_zero_of_mem_basicOpen C p hp hple hpmem)
341	      (hval.symm.trans (by rw [h0, map_zero]))
342	  -- membership in the basic open upstairs, via the one-point space `Spec L`
343	  have hmemL : IsLocalRing.closedPoint L ∈ (Spec (.of L)).basicOpen
344	      ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).appLE
345	        ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊤ hqle f) := by
346	    have hnonempty : ((Spec (.of L)).basicOpen
347	        ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).appLE
348	          ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊤ hqle f) : Set (Spec (.of L))).Nonempty := by
349	      by_contra h
350	      rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot, basicOpen_eq_bot_iff] at h
351	      exact hne0 h
352	    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hnonempty
353	    have hy' : y = (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
354	    rwa [hy'] at hy
355	  -- transport down to the basic open of the chart, then into `W`
356	  have hmem2 : IsLocalRing.closedPoint L ∈
357	      Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp ⁻¹ᵁ
358	        (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.basicOpen f := by
359	    have heq : (Spec (.of L)).basicOpen
360	        ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).appLE
361	          ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊤ hqle f) =
362	        ⊤ ⊓ (Spec (.of L)).basicOpen
363	          ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).app
364	            ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) f) := by
365	      have h : (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).appLE
366	          ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊤ hqle f =
367	          (Spec (.of L)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hqle).op
368	            ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).app
369	              ((fst C (overSpec k L)).left ⁻¹ᵁ U) f) := rfl
370	      rw [h, Scheme.basicOpen_res]
371	    rw [heq] at hmemL
372	    rw [Scheme.preimage_basicOpen]
373	    exact hmemL.2
374	  exact ⟨p, hp, (hfW hmem2).1⟩
375	
376	end Density

# Rational points of a smooth curve over a separably closed field (DAT-P)

The density brick **DAT-P** of the Wave-4 DATUM campaign (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §4
DAT-P, §5 risk 4). Over a **separably closed** field `K`, the `K`-rational points of a scheme
smooth of relative dimension `1` over `K` are dense: every nonempty open contains one.

## Why smoothness is essential (and closed points are not enough)

Over an imperfect separably closed field `K` (e.g. a separable closure of `𝔽ₚ(t)`) not every
closed point is `K`-rational: `𝔸¹_K` has closed points with residue field `K(a^{1/p})`. So the
algebraically-closed argument (`AlgebraicGeometry.pointEquivClosedPoint`, "every closed point is
rational") **fails**. What survives is density of `K`-points, via the standard-smooth chart:

* a standard-smooth chart of relative dimension `1` is étale over the affine line `𝔸¹`;
* over the **infinite** field `K` a `K`-rational base point of `𝔸¹` lies under the chart;
* the fibre there is a finite separable, indeed étale, `K`-algebra, which over the separably
  closed `K` splits into copies of `K` — giving the rational point.

The commutative-algebra core is `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.SeparablyClosedFibre`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.SeparablyClosed.exists_algHom_of_etale_mvPoly`); this file glues it to the
scheme-level chart machinery of `SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1`.

## Main results (`AlgebraicGeometry.SeparablyClosed`)

* `exists_rationalPoint_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_one` — a **nonempty** scheme smooth of
  relative dimension `1` over a separably closed field `K` has a `K`-point `Spec K ⟶ X` over `K`.
* `exists_rationalPoint_mem` — **the keystone (density form).** For `f : X ⟶ Spec K` smooth of
  relative dimension `1` over a separably closed `K` and any nonempty open `W` of `X`, there is a
  `K`-point `p : Spec K ⟶ X` over `K` whose topological image lies in `W`. Instantiates at any
  separably closed field of the standing curve pack (`[SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]`) with
  the open given as a nonempty open of the underlying space; consumed by DAT-B's coverage argument
  (the P4(c) `h⁰`-drop with points at `kˢ`-levels).
* `Over.exists_rationalPoint_mem` — the same, phrased for the standing pack `C : Over (Spec K)`.

```

    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) (t : T.left) :
    ∃ c : ChartIndex C, t ∈ chartLocus c lam
```

`chartLocus` the CO-SIGNED CHART-U(a) predicate (§1.6): the fibre class
`λ_t · θ^m · (Σ-shift)⁻¹` at `κ(t)` has, after some (equivalently any) finite
separable splitting `L` of the plus class, `h⁰ = 1` and `h¹ = 0` — equivalently an
effective degree-`g` witness with vanishing `H¹` (the two spellings agree by the
rank anchor `h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one`,

2. **Degree.**  `degAt λ t = 0` (`mem_pic0Subgroup_iff`, `Pic0Functor.lean:121`);

   outside the base locus of the current system, give

6. **Package.**  `Σ := Σᵢ single(xᵢ)` is an effective `K_s`-divisor of degree
